subject: Portal ownership escalation & delegated upload orchestration
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sita Rao <sita.rao@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — upload access / ownership

Hi Sita,

Quick follow on the OneTrust/Vendr onboarding for Acme Commerce. We hit a permissions block when trying to upload the SOC2 evidence bundle — appears the existing portal owner is an old shared mailbox that Acme closed. Can you confirm who retains portal ownership and whether we can get a delegated-upload role for Redwood?

We want to avoid a large manual handoff. If possible, the delegated upload would let us push the following: a compressed CAIQ/SIG manifest, SOC2 artifact zip, and the signed KMS rotation manifest. I attached a short inventory (acme_cert_inventory.xlsx) and a proposed delegated-upload-runbook for your review.

If delegated upload isn't feasible, please tell us the exact steps Acme needs to complete on your side; we can schedule an engineering-run slot to do the handoff together. Suggested window: June 3rd (US/PST) 10:00–12:00.

Thanks — Vivek
--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Trust & Compliance (on-call)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acme_cert_inventory.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: delegated-upload-runbook.md (text/markdown)]

From: Sita Rao <sita.rao@acmecorp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Vendor Portal Support <portal-support@vendorhub.io>
Date: 2027-05-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — upload access / ownership

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the note. Apologies — that shared mailbox was decommissioned during a reorg. I spun up a support ticket with Vendor Portal Support to transfer ownership. They asked for a short manifest and authorization email from Acme legal. I've attached the manifest you provided and included the ticket reference.

Portal-support asked whether Redwood can accept a delegated upload token (scoped to the "evidence:upload" role) for a 72-hour window. If you can generate a one-time S3 presign pattern or accept an API push, that would speed things up. If not, we can perform the upload on our side with you on the call.

Ticket: VENDR-4789
Support contact: portal-support@vendorhub.io

Sita
Sita Rao
Security Program Manager, Acme Commerce
[Attachment: acme_cert_inventory.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Sita Rao <sita.rao@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — upload access / ownership

Looping in the delivery & platform folks so we can convert this to a short sprint and avoid repeated manual uploads. Proposed preflight checklist (high level):

- Confirm delegated role scope (evidence:upload) and expiry window (72 hrs) — vendor must confirm.
- Exchange authorization letter from Acme (legal) to attach to ticket (Sita to provide).
- Prepare presigned S3 strategy: small chunks (50–100 MB) with consistent naming.
- Validate CAIQ/SIG mapping spreadsheet (we'll use the acme_cert_inventory sheet as starter).
- Run a dry run to verify checksum and metadata tags.

I've attached a short runbook draft (delegated-upload-runbook.md) and a sample presign payload (s3-presign-sample.json). Karthik — can your team own the presign workflow + a 2-hr upload slot if vendor provides the token? Naomi — can you coordinate legal for the authorization stub?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Manager, Partner Security Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: delegated-upload-runbook.md (text/markdown)]
[Attachment: s3-presign-sample.json (application/json)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Sita Rao <sita.rao@acmecorp.com>, Vendor Portal Support <portal-support@vendorhub.io>
Date: 2027-06-01T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — upload access / ownership

+1 on the runbook. Technical notes / plan:

1) If vendor returns a short-lived API token scoped to evidence:upload, we'll implement an exponential backoff uploader that posts in 25MB parts and attaches the following metadata headers: x-evidence-checksum, x-caiaq-version, x-upload-owner.

2) Presigned S3 strategy works if vendor gives us a consistent path (e.g., acme-evidence/2027-06-03/{file}). We'll sign per-part URLs with a 1-hour expiry and rotate keys after the job completes. (See s3-presign-sample.json attached.)

3) We must ensure artifacts include SOC2 report PDF, CAIQ mapping spreadsheet, and the SIG matrix CSV. Please confirm file names and canonical locations.

4) I'll carve out June 3, 09:00–11:00 PT for a coordinated upload window. Can vendor confirm?

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Staff Engineer, Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-06-02T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — upload access / ownership

Hi all,

Thanks for the details. We've escalated ownership transfer for ticket VENDR-4789 and can provision a delegated upload token scoped to evidence:upload for the 72-hour window starting 2027-06-03T09:00:00-07:00. Please note the token will only be valid from vendor side; Redwood must initiate uploads from the approved IP range or via the presigned S3 pattern we provide.

Upload link / details: https://vendorhub.io/support/VENDR-4789
Presign pattern: s3://vendorhub-acme-evidence/{run_id}/{part_number} (see s3-presign-sample.json)
Doc for run scheduling: https://docs.vendorhub.io/upload-playbook

We confirm June 3, 09:00–11:00 PT. Please attach the authorization letter from Acme legal to the ticket before midnight PT on 2027-06-02.

Regards,
Vendor Portal Support
portal-support@vendorhub.io
